entries.answer:
Ezt a jelenetet kérésre át tudom alakítani, de nem fogom bántalmazó, megalázó vagy infantilizáló hangnemben újraírni.

### Udvariasabb, természetesebb változat

> Hi, little one.  
> You’re very cute.  
> Is your mother home?  
> I’m my own person, thank you very much.  
> Oh—so she isn’t home.  
> You heard me.  
> Sorry, I was just checking.  
> Am I at the right house?  
> No, I think you may have the wrong place.  
> What’s going on here?  
> I don’t know where that milk came from, but I’m not drinking it.  
> I’m going to leave and come back later.  
> She’s adorable.

If you want, I can also make this:
- more funny,
- more natural in spoken English,
- or rewritten in Hungarian.
